name: sessile
description: Your Claude Code sessions in a pane docked beside the conversation: search, rename, archive, export and delete, here or in every project

cliPath.title: sessile binary
cliPath.description: Path to the sessile CLI (resolved through PATH when bare)

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: pane: takes the keyboard on open (docked at the side in fullscreen); band: full width above the prompt, ctrl+x tab to focus

dockBackground.title: Docked pane background
dockBackground.description: Background of the pane when docked beside the transcript, e.g. your terminal's background as hex (#1a1b26 for TokyoNight); empty keeps Claude Code's own

exportDir.title: Export directory
exportDir.description: Where m writes a session as markdown (~ allowed); empty writes into the directory of the session the pane runs in
